changelog:
Summary: Major update — switched to ChartGen API, rewrote workflow, removed Python scripts, added Node.js tooling.

- Migrated from custom Python scripts to the official ChartGen API and Node.js tool.
- Skill renamed to "chartgen" and refocused on ChartGen platform capabilities.
- Completely revised workflow: every request requires user confirmation; added detailed 5-step process for analysis tasks.
- Tooling changed: added tools/chartgen_api.js, removed all Python analysis/visualization scripts.
- Expanded use cases to include dashboards, diagrams, and PPT generation, with detailed handling for all result types.
- Prerequisites updated: Node.js 14+ required, API key environment setup simplified.
